description:
Recursive(f) is answered by the engine: DeriveRecursive(f) waits on its static callees' Recursive, and f is recursive when its group has more than one member or a self-wait. Deletes ReachKey::Static, its product arm, ProductAddress::program if left unused, and Static reach telemetry. Proven (develop f822f0f84): the Static reach set's only production reader is derive_recursive (jobs/keying.rs ~263-272), which reads only reach.contains(Static(f)); the bit is load-bearing (key collapse, world.rs ~961, ~2521). Probe first: Recursive identical on the corpus. Note fz-229: StaticCallees omits closure/dispatch/function-ref edges; Recursive today is defined over StaticCallees and this ticket keeps that definition. Spike reference: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/reachfact/.

REFUTED 2026-11-14 (scratchpad t93_3/findings.md; spikes spike_waitgroups.diff, spike_readgraph.diff; probe probe_test_h2.rs.txt + probe_fixtures/):
- Wait-group membership: static corpus identical (1205 files, SCC oracle 0 mismatches over 22,399 functions), but a cycle REMOVED by redefinition stays Recursive=true (po/pe probe; base goes false), because a group forms only when two pending jobs meet and never shrinks. (The add-edge 611/612 failure in the first spike was a spike bug: StaticCallees was not read.) Same staleness confirmed independently on fz-afu.15 groups (scratchpad h1/report.md case 3: an off-cycle member stays in the group).
- Read-graph formulation (DFS over DeriveRecursive jobs' recorded reads): both edit directions correct, corpus identical, but it is a hand-written reachability walk re-hosting what Reach(Static) already computes, costs a rescan per run (+0.32% distiller instructions, DeriveRecursive 285 -> 844 runs), moves nine pins, and has an argued stale-false hole (no wake when an already-true node gains a new cycle).
- Conclusion: Recursive(f) is a property of the static call graph, not of the scheduling groups; it stays a derived fact over StaticCallees (Reach Static). Not built.

REOPENED 2026-11-14 (user-approved plan /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-next.html): the refutation above leaned on spike evidence that does not settle the idea. Stale membership is a defect filed as fz-t93.18 (groups shrink), not a flaw of the idea; the read-graph version was correct and its +0.32% is per-read cost that fz-t93.19 targets. Experiment first, after fz-t93.18: re-run the seven edit cases (scratchpad h1/report.md) and the 22,399-function corpus oracle with shrinking groups. Buys if it holds: Reach(Static) deleted; cycles have one owner.
title: A function is recursive exactly when its derivation's cycle group is cyclic
